Posted inArtificial Intelligence

Deloitte survey exposes compliance gaps as a third of employees admit using shadow GenAI at work

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread
by Ruth Prickett September 24, 2026September 24, 2026

Share this:

  • Share on LinkedIn (Opens in new window) LinkedIn
  • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook
  • Share on X (Opens in new window) X

Nearly a third of generative AI users bring their own GenAI tools to work and use them without their employer’s knowledge, raising important compliance concerns over issues such as cyber risks, copyright and audit trails. A new survey from Big Four consultancy Deloitte UK also found that nearly half of the employees using GenAI at work had no formal training on how to use it safely in the workplace.

The GenAI Workforce Survey found that almost a quarter (24%) of UK workers now use GenAI tools every day for work. However, nearly two-thirds said they lacked leadership on how GenAI should be used in their organization.
